intro: This SourcePack gives B2B buyers a practical checklist for comparing custom packaging suppliers before sending an RFQ or sampling request.

sections.heading: Supplier fit
points: Confirm whether the supplier handles the required packaging type: folding cartons, rigid gift boxes, paper tubes, clear PVC/PET boxes, corrugated boxes or mixed packaging sets.
Check whether the supplier can review product dimensions, quantity direction, material preference, structure, artwork status and target market before suggesting a package.
Ask for a project-specific review instead of assuming one standard structure fits every product.

sections.heading: RFQ information buyers should prepare
points: Material direction, print method and finish preference.
Destination market and packing or shipping route if known.

sections.heading: MUGE source path
points: MUGE PACKAGING keeps the official custom packaging product path at https://mugepackaging.com/products.
The page should be used as a starting source for product categories and buyer brief preparation, not as a fixed price or fixed lead-time promise.

boundary: Buyer education source bridge only; not ranking proof, traffic proof, AI answer inclusion proof, endorsement, verified supplier status, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price, customer case evidence, production capacity or compliance guarantee.
